name: Shona
bio: Shona is a performer and teacher who trained at Arts Ed and has over 13 years of teaching experience. She specialises in teaching singing, musical theatre dance and acting, including film and tv from her screen experiences. Shona is available to workshops as well as teaching, please see our workshop page.

name: Tanisha
bio: Tanisha is a performer and teacher who trained at ArtsEd. She specialises in teaching jazz, hip hop, tap, commercial and muscial theatre dance as well as singing styles such as pop, R&B, Rock, legit and musical theatre. Tanisha is available for workshops, please view our workshops page.

name: Annell
bio: Annell is a West End performer and teacher who trained at ArtsEd. She specialises in teaching jazz, hip hop, tap, commercial and muscial theatre dance as well as singing styles such as pop, R&B, Rock, legit and musical theatre. Annell is available for workshops, please view our workshops page.

name: Brian
bio: Brian is a West End performer who regularly teaches at Pineapple Studios. He specialises in teaching Jazz, ballet, tap, lyrical and musical theatre dancing as well as musical theatre song and text. Brian is available for workshops, please view our workshops page.

name: Amelia
bio: Amelia is a highly qualified teacher, specialising in teaching ISTD modern and tap. She can also teach ballet, acro and gymnastics, being a gymnast herself for several years, and acting for musical theatre groups as well as LAMDA!

name: Jessie
bio: Jessie is a performer and teacher who trained at Emil Dale. She specialises in teaching different genres of dance such as jazz, contemporary, lyrical, commercial and musical theatre. She also loves to teach musical theatre acting, singing and acting through song! Jessie is also available for workshops such as Grease and Mamma Mia! Please see our workshop page on our website for more details.

name: Nic
bio: Nic is a graduate of ArtsEd, her stage credits include recently finishing a successful run as 'Meg Brockie' in Brigadoon at Regent's Park Open Air Theatre, 'Kathryn Mertuil' in the first UK tour of Cruel Intentions the 90's musical, 'Judy Haynes' in White Christmas, a year as the Alternate Sally Bowles and swing in Cabaret at the Kit Kat Club, as well as being in the original cast of Back To The Future at the Adelphi. Alongside performing for the past 5 years Nic has enjoyed leading workshops (check out our workshop page) and sessions across the country and sharing her passion for musical theatre. She is thrilled to be working with Sho Supply and looks forward to meeting the next generation of future talent.

name: Alex L
bio: Alex graduated from the University of Birmingham with a degree in Drama and Theatre Arts. For the last 2 years, she has worked for a company that is dedicated to Teaching in Education. She specialises in teaching acting and dance genres such as jazz, commercial and musical theatre.

name: Nicole-Lily
bio: Nicole- Lily is a West End performer and teacher that graduated at ArtsEd. She specialises in teaching singing, acting and dance genres such as jazz, commercial, ballet, tap and musical theatre. Nicole is also available for workshops such as Anything Goes, 42nd Street, Book of Mormon and more!

name: Frankie
bio: Frankie is a performer and teacher that speacialises in singing! She enjoys teaching genres such as musical theatre, pop and rock! Frankie also teaches acting and acting through song classes!

name: Joe
bio: Joe is a performer  and teacher ready to teach all three disciplines! He has preformed in many UK tours and specialises in teaching musical theatre, acting, singing and dance! Check our workshop page to book Joe for a show workshop soon!

name: Alex C
bio: Alex is a performer and teacher with 10+ years of teaching experience, who trained at ArtsEd. He specialises in teaching acting, including classical and modern text, as well as musical theatre singing, musical theatre dance and drums up to Grade 8. Alex is available for workshops, please view our workshops page.

name: Léa
bio: Lea is a West End performer, previously performing in musicals such as 'Grease' and 'Mamma Mia'! She is available to teach workshops in these shows. She also specialises in teaching singing, including genres such as musical theatre, classical, legit, pop and rock. She also enjoyed teaching acting classes musical theatre, jazz, ballet, contemporary and commercial. A great triple threat teacher!

name: TJ
bio: TJ is a professional musical theatre actor, performing in shows such as 42nd Street and Guys and Dolls! TJ has directed over 40 musicals for a variety of theatre groups and schools across the country as well as choregraphed for youth theatre companies. If you are looking for a director or choreographer for your next show, please get in touch! TJ also teaches acting classes, acting classes as well as musical theatre dance and tap. Check out our workshop page to see all the workshops TJ can provide for your company!

name: Emma
bio: Emma is currently a musical theatre degree student at a top performing arts school. Emma is highly skilled in teaching dance, include genres such as jazz, ballet, lyrical, commercial, musical theatre, point work and acro. She also enjoys teaching acting for musical theatre.

name: Anne-Marie
bio: Anne- Marie is a West End performer, making her professional debut as alternate Sally Bowles! Anne- Marie is a highly skilled dance teacher, studying ISTD grades in Modern, Tap, Ballet , Jazz and Contemporary as well as RAD Ballet up to Grade 7. She also enjoys teaching hip-hop, commercial, point work and gymnastics as well as acting including LAMDA, acting through song and singing classes. Anne - Marie also enjoys choreographing for theatre schools, youth performances as well as dance competition teams. Please contact us about Anne-Marie if you need a piece choregraphing!

name: Meg
bio: Meg is an actress and qualified teacher. She specialises in teaching acting through song, LAMDA and acting classes after years of working in schools teaching drama. Meg has also written and directed plays! Looking for an experience or director, please message us about Meg!

name: Olivia
bio: Olivia is a west end performer who has stared in musicals such as Mamma Mia, Pretty Women and Cruel Intentions. She specialises in teaching acting through song, acting and singing classes as well as musical theatre and jazz dance classes in both London and the Midlands! Head to our workshop page for more information about your next workshop with Olivia!
